about: HarnessKit curated catalog. verified=direct means the repository files were read for this entry; verified=survey means a research pass read the repository docs but install commands should be re-checked once before use.

conflict_types.trigger: Two items fire on the same request, so which one runs changes from run to run.
conflict_types.contradiction: Two items give opposite instructions for the same situation.
conflict_types.slot: Two items compete for a slot only one can hold (output style, session-start bootstrap, process owner).
conflict_types.role: Two items do the same job (two memory systems, two HWP readers), doubling cost and splitting state.
conflict_types.side-effect: Two items change the same setting, file, or network path.

entries.name: HarnessKit
entries.always_on: Skill description only (one skill). No hooks.

conflicts.detail: Both respond to requests such as '하네스 구성해줘' and '하네스 회고', so either may run.
conflicts.resolve: Disable the original harness plugin while using HarnessKit; HarnessKit already carries its procedure (Apache-2.0 fork).

entries.name: Harness v2 (revfactory)
use_when: You want the upstream harness without HarnessKit's inventory and conflict check.
skip_when: HarnessKit is installed; it already includes this procedure.

entries.name: Superpowers
use_when: Solo development without a HarnessKit harness, where you want a strict brainstorm -> plan -> TDD -> verify process.
skip_when: The project has a HarnessKit/Harness orchestrator that already owns the work process.
Mostly non-code work (reports, documents).

codex: See the repository README for the Codex setup (AGENTS.md based).

entries.always_on: SessionStart hook (startup|clear|compact) injects skills/using-superpowers/SKILL.md (~3.2k chars) into every session, plus 14 skill descriptions.

conflicts.detail: using-superpowers: 'Invoke relevant or requested skills BEFORE any response or action' and 'announce "Using [skill] to [purpose]"'. Attention-kind: 'Lead with the bottom line, in one sentence. The first sentence carries the single most important takeaway'. Both claim the first line of every reply.
conflicts.resolve: Pick one, or add a precedence line: 'The first sentence is the conclusion; skill-use announcements go after it or are omitted.'

conflicts.detail: using-superpowers: 'If you think there is even a 1% chance a skill might apply ... you ABSOLUTELY MUST invoke the skill' and 'Skill check comes BEFORE clarifying questions'. Karpathy: 'If something is unclear, stop. Name what's confusing. Ask.' and 'For trivial tasks, use judgment.' They disagree on what comes first and on whether small tasks get the full process. Their brainstorming and 'Think Before Coding' parts also do the same job (role overlap).
conflicts.resolve: Let one own the pre-coding step. If both stay, add: 'For trivial tasks skip brainstorming; when unclear, ask before invoking process skills.'

conflicts.detail: Superpowers brainstorming says 'You MUST use this before any creative work' and its plan/execute skills define the whole work process; a HarnessKit orchestrator defines its own process and pre-work check.
conflicts.resolve: In projects with a HarnessKit harness, disable Superpowers for that project, or tell the orchestrator to delegate the process to Superpowers and drop its own pre-work check.

entries.name: Karpathy Guidelines
entries.license: MIT (declared in plugin.json and SKILL.md; the repository has no LICENSE file)
use_when: Coding work where the AI tends to over-build, touch unrelated code, or assume silently.
skip_when: Non-code work.
entries.always_on: One short skill description. No hooks.

entries.name: Attention Span (Attention-kind output style)
entries.license: AGPL-3.0 (link only; do not copy files into HarnessKit)
use_when: You want conclusion-first, shorter replies in every session.
skip_when: Another output style is already selected.
You need long-form drafting as the default.
entries.always_on: When selected, the Attention-kind output style (~8.7k chars) is part of every turn's system prompt. Four skill descriptions. No hooks.
entries.external_data: None (PRIVACY.md: no telemetry, no network calls, no hooks).

entries.name: Humanize KR (im-not-ai)
use_when: Korean reports, posts, or documents that read like AI or translated text.
skip_when: Fact checking (it rewrites style only).
Non-Korean text.
entries.always_on: Two model-invocable skill descriptions plus nine subagent descriptions (~3.3k chars). Six of the nine agents maintain the plugin itself (taxonomy, scholarship, metrics, release) and are rarely needed by users.

entries.name: Anthropic document skills (docx, xlsx, pptx, pdf)
use_when: Creating or editing Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or PDF files.
skip_when: HWP documents (use kordoc).
Machines where LibreOffice cannot be installed.

entries.name: kordoc (HWP/HWPX)
use_when: Reading HWP/HWPX, comparing versions, filling forms, writing HWPX.
skip_when: The output must be .docx.

claude: Set KORDOC_OFFLINE=1 to block all network access

entries.external_data: OCR model download once (huggingface) and optional webhook; KORDOC_OFFLINE=1 blocks both.

entries.name: Context7
use_when: Writing code against a library whose API changes between versions.
skip_when: General research or standards documents (Context7 indexes software libraries).
Code that must not leave the company: queries go to context7.com.

entries.name: Trail of Bits static-analysis
use_when: Running CodeQL/Semgrep or triaging SARIF results.
skip_when: No CodeQL/Semgrep CLI available.

entries.name: Trail of Bits fp-check
use_when: A focused session judging whether static-analysis findings are false positives.
skip_when: Everyday sessions: it adds a Stop hook of type prompt, so an LLM judgment runs at the end of every reply.
entries.always_on: Stop hook (type: prompt) on every reply while enabled.

entries.name: Trail of Bits mutation-testing / property-based-testing
use_when: Checking how strong an existing test suite is, or adding property tests.
skip_when: The language or framework is not supported by the tools.

entries.name: Playwright (MCP)
use_when: Running or reproducing web UI end-to-end tests.
skip_when: Non-web targets (embedded, desktop).

codex: Add @playwright/mcp as an MCP server (see the repository README)

entries.always_on: MCP tool names only; page snapshots are large while in use.

conflicts.detail: agent-browser's skill description says 'Prefer agent-browser over any built-in browser automation', so both claim browser tasks.

entries.name: agent-browser (Vercel)
use_when: You prefer a CLI browser driver and do not use Playwright.
skip_when: Playwright is installed.
entries.always_on: One skill description written to be chosen over other browser tools.

entries.name: Headroom (context compression proxy)
use_when: Sessions dominated by large logs, JSON, or tool output, after confirming company policy allows a local proxy.
skip_when: Short prose work: little to compress.
Company policy forbids routing API traffic through a local proxy.
entries.always_on: All API traffic passes through a local proxy while wrapped. Its plugin adds SessionStart and PreToolUse hooks.
entries.external_data: Anonymous telemetry beacon on by default (turn off with HEADROOM_TELEMETRY=off). Checks PyPI for updates.
entries.notes: On the Anthropic path the default cache mode skips automatic --memory injection; --mode token is needed for memory, at the cost of prompt-cache stability.

conflicts.detail: Both store and re-inject session memory.
conflicts.resolve: Use one memory system, or Claude Code's built-in auto memory.

conflicts.detail: Rewrites the API base URL; may clash with a company proxy or gateway.

entries.name: claude-mem
skip_when: Company environments: sends recorded activity to an external LLM; analytics on by default.
entries.always_on: Nine hooks including SessionStart (injects past records) and Pre/PostToolUse (records every tool call).
entries.external_data: Recorded activity sent to an external LLM provider; analytics on by default.

entries.name: k-skill (full install)
use_when: Install only the single skill you need, not the bundle.
skip_when: Full install: 134 skill descriptions load in every session.
entries.external_data: Many skills call public web APIs.

entries.name: ccusage
use_when: Measuring token use before and after a harness change.
entries.external_data: Reads local ~/.claude/projects logs; --offline avoids the online price lookup.

entries.name: SkillSpector (NVIDIA)
use_when: Before installing a skill or plugin that is not in this catalog.
skip_when: LLM mode: it sends file contents to an external model; use --no-llm.

claude: Run with --no-llm (see the repository README for the scan command)

entries.external_data: --no-llm: static only, but dependency checks send package names and versions to OSV.dev.
